title: Minimalism
body:
First I admit that I am not a web designer, but a design lover.

Minimalism refers to a certain style and applies in many fields: Art, architecture, literature, and philosophy as a ==way of life==.

> [!NOTE] Zen is not the lack of clutter; it is the deliberate presence of purpose.

## Core Principles
- [x] Strip work down to its most **fundamental features**
- [x] Embrace deliberate whitespace and calm typography
- [ ] Focus on tactile, physical book aesthetic
- [ ] Practice daily reflection and minimal journaling

> Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

```rust
fn zen_state() -> &'static str {
    "Serenity in simplicity"
}
```

Are you a designer who hides behind ornament, or one who crafts `essential harmony`?
